name: Azure Functions

evidence.paas: 03: managed function execution; the customer uploads function code and Azure runs it

line: Run event driven and HTTP functions on managed Azure compute.

cells.regions: East US example; many Azure regions

work.math: Static files need separate storage, or a function design with a clearly stated scope.
1 million isolated periods of 1 second each: 500,000 GB-seconds minus a 100,000 GB-second grant = $10.40, plus $0.30 for extra executions. Host storage and logs cost extra.
The small app API's $10.70 isolated-period example, plus $133.62 for PostgreSQL compute and 32 GiB of storage. Host storage, logs, backup excess and network costs vary.
